Description: Monorepo wiring for web portals: Next.js apps + shared component/types packages. Definition of done: all portal shells build in CI.

Task Name: Web design tokens & component library v1
Description: Design tokens + core components for all three portals (tables, forms, status chips, cards, nav). English-only portals. Single library — ESM/Contractor/Admin share it.
Email+password login, mandatory MFA for Admin/Super-Admin, session handling, forced-logout support, route protection per role.
React Native (Expo) scaffold, navigation, env config, Android-first build pipeline. Definition of done: dev build installs on an Android 8 / 2GB device.
Icon-led components, large touch targets, minimal-typing patterns, error states that speak. This is the accessibility core of the product — not a polish item.
Phone OTP flow with retry/cooldown states, brute-force lockout messaging, session persistence. No passwords for candidates.
Language choice (Kannada/Hindi/English) at first launch + in settings; loads DB-stored language packs; every string keyed, no hardcoded copy.
Speaker icon on every screen; plays 5–10s pre-recorded prompt in chosen language; audio cached on device after first play; graceful state when asset missing (script locks wk 9).
Guided first-run: language → OTP → minimal profile, voice prompt per step. Target: a semi-literate candidate completes signup in ~10 minutes with ESM help or alone.
Photograph certificates/ID/handwritten résumés: multi-page capture, framing guides, blur/quality hints, review-and-retake. Dominant input type — this flow carries the product.
PDF/DOCX picker path for digitally fluent candidates; progress + failure states.
Structured form entry (self or ESM-assisted): qualification, experience, languages, relocation willingness. Highest-quality parser input; form values take precedence over parsed.
The CIBIL-like score/badge with explainable breakdown (which dimensions contributed). Renders engine output only — no client-side computation.
Territory-matched openings list with role/location/salary band. Employer identity never present in payload or UI.
Per-application timeline: matched → presented → accepted → joined, with plain-language + voice explanation of each state.
Locate nearest fulfilment centre/ESM by district; call/directions actions.
In-app intake used by ESMs at the centre: create candidate on their behalf, reuse capture flows (10–12) with ESM-assisted variants.
Verification checklist per territory: confirm each placed head still active; offline-tolerant, queued sync. Feeds billing — states must be unambiguous.
FCM registration, notification routing to screens, in-app inbox; templates arrive multilingual from backend.
Queue-and-retry for all writes on 3G/patchy networks; visible pending/synced states; no silent data loss.
Cold start <4s on Android 8/2GB, lean install size, image-capture memory profile, list virtualisation.
Candidates · placements · earnings overview for the centre lead; territory-scoped data only.
Status workflow met → suitable → callback → placed → joined; drag/tap transitions with audit-logged changes.
Territory-matched contractor requirements, employer identity masked; forward/match candidates against a requirement.
Retention view: 'these N left this month — call them'; outcome capture per call.
Month-on-month per-active-head earnings, payout status, statement history. Figures rendered from billing engine only.
Requirement form: role, headcount, location, salary range, terms; edit/close lifecycle.
Scored candidate list per requirement (identity-appropriate fields only, employer masked from their reads where applicable); accept/reject actions.
Supplied headcount vs joined vs active per requirement over time.
Monthly invoices (per active head), line items, status (raised/collected/overdue), downloadable statements.
Admin console frame with sub-role gating (Reviewer/Ops/Finance/ESM Mgr/Sales). UI gating is UX only — server enforces; hide what the role can't touch.
Side-by-side: source document image vs parsed fields vs score; edit any field, adjust score, approve/reject. Every override logged. The parser's safety net — highest-traffic admin screen early.
Weight editor per job category (must sum to 100%), preview against sample candidates, version history.
CRUD/list/search over candidates, ESMs, contractors, requirements with sub-role scoping.
View/adjust matches across territories; reassign; exception queue.
Invoice runs, collections status, reconciliation view, ESM payout runs with approval step. Manual-assisted at R1 — the UI is the workflow.
R1 basics: placements, active heads, collections, parser accuracy/override rate, territory funnel.
Scoped append-only audit browser incl. masked-employer-field read events (bypass detection) with anomaly filters.
RBAC editor, system config (languages/pricing/billing rules), territory setup, feature flags, language-pack editor (edit strings without release).
Error/empty/loading states everywhere, masked-field leak check on every ESM/Contractor view, session-expiry behaviour, pilot-readiness QA.
Native-speaker pass on every candidate-app string and voice prompt; per-language structured test scripts; layout breakage from long strings.
Full voice coverage, notification polish, perf regression check, store-listing assets.
Portal polish, full analytics dashboards, billing-automation UI states (auto-run + exception handling replacing manual-assisted).
